messages:
maria_ae: Hey team — Day 0 for Nebula.ai trial is next Tues at 11am PT. Quick thread to align agenda, success metrics, and immediate asks from eng/security. Tara from Nebula will join.

sam_se: Thanks — can we confirm scope? From the call yesterday they want: ingest -> semantic search -> summarization pipeline. Expect ~200k docs, average query length 120 tokens.

maria_ae: Yep correct. Tara confirmed those three flows and wants SLA-ish latency targets for search (p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms) and summarize (p50 < 700ms).

jin_cs: For success criteria, we should propose: 1) end-to-end latency targets met under 75 RPS burst; 2) embedding quality/recall >= 0.78 on the 500-sample eval set; 3) cost per 1k queries within the modeled budget (I have a cost calc).

lena_sre: Note on infra: 200k docs + 75 RPS suggests we recommend Dedicated with KV cache on their most common prefixes. Otherwise host mode will throttle. Also need to know average doc length (tokens) for mem planning.

maria_ae: Tara — can you drop average doc size and whether docs are frequently edited? also any compliance notes (SOC2/PDF attachments)?

tara_customer: avg doc ~1.2k chars (~230 tokens). Edits are rare (~2% per week). We'll be sending PDFs and some docx; some attachments contain PII. SOC2 is required, and we need audit log delivery.

omar_security: PII + SOC2 — we'll need to propose Private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS. Also send us their completed security questionnaire before the kickoff so we can preflight any gaps.

maria_ae: I'll attach the questionnaire to the calendar invite. Can engineering review the questionnaire responses and flag blockers 48h before the call?

sam_se: Yes. Also we should prepare a short eval harness: 500 sample prompts, 1k negative examples, and a reranking baseline. I'll drop a starter test matrix in this thread.

sam_se: ```
# Eval matrix (starter)
- flow: semantic_search
  - metric: recall@10
  - target: >=0.78
- flow: summarization
  - metric: ROUGE-L / human spot-check
  - target: 85% pass rate on 100 hand-checked prompts
- perf: p95 latency under load
  - target: search p95 <400ms, summarize p95 <1200ms
```

jin_cs: I can own prompt set curation + human spot-check. Estimate 6-8 hrs of labeling for summarization spot-check. Who's on QA side from Nebula?

tara_customer: I'll have Priya (data lead) on the call; she can help with labeling review and sample selection.

lena_sre: On the config side, we'll propose: quantized model variant for Dedicated, autoscale policy with max 150 RPS (burst headroom), and prefix KV-caching for top 20 intents. Need their expected concurrent users and traffic pattern (steady vs spiky).

maria_ae: Action items: 1) Tara to upload security questionnaire + sample doc dump by Fri EOD. 2) Sam to post starter eval matrix and runbook (by Thu). 3) Omar/lena to preflight infra and list any blockers (48h before kickoff). 4) Jin to prepare prompt sets and labeling plan.

omar_security: One more — if they require audit logs retention >90 days we need to confirm retention add-on pricing with legal.

maria_ae: Good call. I'll loop in finance/legal after questionnaire lands.

tara_customer: Sending questionnaire now. Thanks all — excited to get started.

sam_se: Quick note for the kickoff agenda (10–15m each): intros, Nebula goals & success criteria, security preflight, infra recommendations, demo of baseline, next steps & timeline.

maria_ae: Perfect. I'll update calendar invite to include those bullets and add links to the questionnaire + sample prompt doc. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your action so I can track.

jin_cs: :thumbsup:

lena_sre: :thumbsup:

omar_security: :thumbsup:

sam_se: :thumbsup:
